title: Was, or were?
cz: Slalom tří branek: was, nebo were?

lessons.title: Gate 1: YOU = were
lessons.intro:
Představ si slalomovou trať se třemi záludnými brankami. Kdo jimi projede čistě, umí was/were. Branka 1: YOU.

Pomůže přítomný čas:
I am → I was · she is → she was
you are → you were · they are → they were
You je „ty“ i „vy“. V obou případech je to were.
❌ you was · ✅ you were
❌ Was you…? · ✅ Were you…?

ex.why: Are se v minulosti mění na were. A protože se říká you are, je to i you were.

ex.s: ___ you sleeping when I called?
ex.why: You → were, i když se ptáš jednoho člověka.

ex.s: Klaudie, ___ you painting yesterday afternoon?
ex.why: Mluvíš na jednu holku, ale pořád je to you → were.

ex.s: You ___ studying all day, right?

opts: Were you having breakfast at half past seven?
Was you having breakfast at half past seven?
ex.a: Were you having breakfast at half past seven?

ex.s: ___ you studying too?
ex.why: You → were, i když jde o jednoho člověka.

ex.s: Your mum said that you ___ sleeping.
ex.why: You → were. Stejně jako you are.

ex.a: What were you doing at seven o’clock?
Were you sleeping? No, I wasn’t.

lessons.title: Gate 2: more people = were
lessons.intro:
Branka 2: víc lidí. Když je ve větě víc lidí nebo věcí, je to were. Pomůže trik: nahraď je slovem they, we, he, she nebo it.

your friends → they → were
Tom and Mike → they → were
my sister → she → was
Mum and I → we → were
Krátká odpověď použije stejné slovo jako trik:
Were your friends wearing jeans? – Yes, they were. / No, they weren’t.

ex.s: Tom and Mike ___ playing football.
Your friends ___ wearing jeans today.
My sister ___ chatting on the phone.

ex.q: Were your friends wearing jeans today? – Yes, …
ex.why: Ptáš se na friends, to jsou they. I odpověď je tedy they were.

ex.s: Mum and I ___ watching TV.
Mum and Dad ___ cooking dinner at seven.
___ the girls dancing at the party? – Yes, they were.

ex.a: Were your friends wearing jeans? Yes, they were.

lessons.title: Gate 3: -ing never goes alone
lessons.intro:
Branka 3. Tvar s -ing nikdy nejede sám. Potřebuje před sebou was nebo were, jako kánoe potřebuje pádlo.

❌ I studying all day.
✅ I was studying all day.
❌ My sister chatting on the phone.
✅ My sister was chatting on the phone.
Pravopis -ing:
chat → chatting · swim → swimming · sit → sitting
make → making (e zmizí) · study → studying

ex.why: Studying potřebuje před sebou was nebo were.

ex.s: My mother ___ cakes for the village fair.
ex.why: Mother = she → was. A k -ing patří vždycky was/were.

ex.s: Dad ___ the dog a bath.

ex.why: Krátké sloveso, které končí jednou souhláskou: souhláska se zdvojí. chat → chatting.
Němé e na konci zmizí: make → making.

ex.s: When I finished, my sister ___ on the phone.
ex.why: My sister = she → was. A chat → chatting (dvě t).

ex.s: I ___ all day yesterday.
My friends ___ in the lake.
ex.why: My friends = they → were. Swim → swimming (dvě m).

ex.s: Klaudie and her friends ___ on the river.
ex.why: Klaudie and her friends = they → were. Paddle → paddling (e zmizí).

ex.cz: Mamka pekla dort a já jsem jí [[pomáhala|pomáhal]].
ex.a: My mum was baking a cake and I was helping her.
I was studying and my sister was chatting.

lessons.title: The final run
lessons.intro:
Finále. Napíšeš e-mail kamarádce. U každé mezery si v duchu projeď všechny tři branky.

🟢 Branka 1: you → were
🔴 Branka 2: víc lidí → were
🟢 Branka 3: -ing nikdy samo → was/were + -ing

Nespěchej. Na trati taky vyhrává ten, kdo jede čistě, ne ten, kdo jede nejrychleji.

ex.s: Hi Ema! Sorry I didn’t answer. I ___ all afternoon.
What ___ you doing at four o’clock?
My brother ___ for lizards in the garden.
Mum and Dad ___ a film.
ex.why: Branka 2: Mum and Dad = they → were.

ex.s: Our dog ___ on the sofa.
It ___ raining, so we didn’t go out.
___ your friends making bracelets at the art club?

ex.q: Were your friends making bracelets? – Yes, …

ex.s: When you called, I ___ in the bath!

ex.a: We were watching a film when you called.
What were you doing yesterday at five o’clock?

writing.title: Co dělala moje rodina včera v šest
writing.task: What were your family doing at six o’clock yesterday? Write about four people (and your pet!).
writing.cz: Napiš, co kdo z rodiny dělal včera v šest hodin. Aspoň 4 věty. U každé si zkontroluj všechny tři branky.
writing.placeholder: At six o’clock yesterday, Mum was… Dad and Robin were… I was…
